Add/rename/reorder a script HERE first, then re-render the CLAUDE.md table row to match -- ci_sweep.sh will hard-fail the sweep if they disagree. seed:null means the script takes no --seed (load_gate, char_creation). fixture is the fixture_save this script's own qa/scripts/<name>.json loads via title Continue (its rng_state overrides --seed when present) -- informational, not consumed by ci_sweep.sh's invocation. note is the one-line purpose column. tiers: hand-curated membership, every entry >=1 of smoke/full, smoke subset of full (ci_sweep.sh drift-checks both facts). smoke = load_gate + one canonical per subsystem, <3min, runs every push. full = everything (unchanged). surfaces: GENERATED ONLY by scripts/derive_qa_surfaces.py from the script+fixture+data files themselves (maps/fixtures/skills/systems referenced) -- never hand-edit; ci_sweep.sh --touching <path> maps changed paths to surface tags to crossing scripts; the drift check re-runs the generator and fails on any mismatch (stale tags = FATAL).
